description:
Colorado —Middle Earth of America.
Here, mountains are not features of the landscape — they are the landscape. 
An immense spine of the Rockies runs through the state, lifting the land to extremes. 
Over fifty summits rise above 14,000 feet, summits exposed to thin air, slopes carved by glaciers.
